note: Norway fiscal authority paths for bottom-up macro (v2). Cash identity is Norges Bank Tab4 → Tab1 government accounts. MoF National Budget / petroleum fund annuals are not yet machine-readable here; live category history is Tab4. Macro determinants: SSB mainland GDP (09190), Brent (FRED DCOILBRENTEU / correlations panel), NB policy rate.

non_oil_deficit.source: MoF National Budget / Revised National Budget (strukturelt, oljekorrigert underskudd) — hand-enter when scraped
non_oil_deficit.note: Empty until MoF tables are entered. Beyond-NB path does not pin to MoF annuals yet; NB liquidity forecast pins inside its published horizon.

mainland_gdp.source: SSB table 09190 Makrost=bnpb.nr23_9fn ContentsCode=Priser (current prices, NOK mn, quarterly)
mainland_gdp.use: YoY of monthly-ffilled level → additive residual driver for mainland Tab4 lines

brent.use: 12m YoY → unit pass-through on oil_tax and sdfi (petroleum cash)

policy_rate.use: 12m change screened for other_net; PRE category MAE does not beat smly — left smly

elasticities.source: Agency priors + PRE-gated expanding OLS (additive residual on driver). No MoF ready-reckoner coefficients published in-repo.

oil_tax.note: Petroleum tax cash scales with oil price YoY on smly base; a priori (category MAE also beats smly)

sdfi.note: SDFI a priori unit_mult with oil_tax (category MAE loses to smly; gating sdfi to smly kills headline PRE)

vat.note: PRE category MAE beats smly; residual × MAINLAND_RESID_WEIGHT

tax_net.note: PRE category MAE beats smly; residual × MAINLAND_RESID_WEIGHT

nav.note: PRE category MAE beats smly; residual × MAINLAND_RESID_WEIGHT

health.note: PRE category MAE beats smly; residual × MAINLAND_RESID_WEIGHT

customs_excise.note: Expanding OLS loses PRE category MAE to smly — calendar/excise steps dominate

local_authorities.note: With MAINLAND_RESID_WEIGHT=0.5, PRE category MAE beats smly (at w=1 it lost)

other_net.note: Heterogeneous residual (incl. interest/one-offs); rate OLS loses PRE

nb_pin.rule: Inside the latest vintage path, cash_requirement_bottomup_bn = production NB residual. Macro Tab4 sum only beyond that horizon.
